GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

This is a shift role. Working 8-hour shifts with 4 weekdays and 1 weekend day.

Support Engineering at GitLab isn’t just a title - you will be embedded within the Engineering department and will truly operate in an environment where Support and Engineering meet. You’ll interact with customers daily as they encounter the difficult edge cases of running GitLab in complex environments. In the space of a day, you might be doing behind the scenes work of a Linux administrator troubleshooting performance problems by using strace on a particular process, interacting with the Product team to ensure that steps in a bug report are reproducible, or interacting with the Engineering team itself by diving deep into our codebase and putting together a merge request to actually fix a customer issue.

That’s not all though - you’d equally be invited to contribute to the source code, improve our documentation, and help build out more efficient support processes in our issue tracker. We want to live in a world where everyone can contribute, and as a member of the support team, there are no barriers to using your skills to improve the experience of our users and customers.

Some examples of our projects:

  • A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues
  • A solution to capture the state of a customer’s server for easier troubleshooting
  • A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns
  • A functionality to ChatOps to make it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com

What you’ll do

  • Collaborate with Support team members (through Pairing Sessions) and other GitLab team members (for example: as a Support Stable Counterpart)
  • Participate in regular rotations for weekday and weekend on-call coverage (daytime only), providing emergency support to our Self-managed and SaaS customers, or working with our SaaS Production team to coordinate incident communications
  • Participate in our hiring processes by reviewing applications and assessments, and by participating in interviews.

What you’ll bring

  • Excellent Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent knowledge)
  • Ability to use scripting languages (preferably Ruby or Bash), and MVC frameworks (preferably Ruby on Rails)
  • Experience with Git and CI/CD
  • Expertise in writing support content

About the team

The Support team is distributed all over the world across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions. Support Engineers work on Support Tickets and helping GitLab’s customers, but they also dig into the code and logs to find out why something is not working as expected. The Collaboration here at GitLab is extraordinary and exciting - Support Engineers solve complex problems together and participate in regular pairing sessions and 1:1s, as well as coffee chats and Slack conversations that help them stay connected. Team members are given the ability to structure their shift the way it best suits their private life while maintaining our ability to address customer issues.

jobs.title: Art Director - Mobile Casual F2P Games
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

UserWise is looking for an experienced Art Director to own and elevate the visual direction of a premium mobile Free-to-Play game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.

This is a hands-on creative leadership role for someone with exceptional visual judgment, deep experience in mobile casual/F2P games, and the ability to lead a small multidisciplinary art team.

You will own the visual quality of the complete game experience across 2D, 3D, UI art, characters, environments, animation, VFX, lighting, and overall presentation. We are looking for someone who can evaluate how the entire game comes together on screen — not just individual assets — and raise the visual bar through clear direction, strong feedback, paintovers, mockups, references, and hands-on iteration when needed.

A key part of this role will be balancing the accessibility and readability of a premium casual mobile game with the spectacle, lighting, personality, excitement, and sense of occasion of a major entertainment property.

The ideal candidate also embraces AI-assisted creative workflows and understands how AI can amplify a talented art team by increasing exploration, accelerating iteration, and allowing artists to focus more time on high-value creative decisions.

What You'll Do

  • Own and evolve the overall art direction and visual identity of the game.
  • Establish and maintain a consistently high visual bar across 2D, 3D, UI, character art, environments, animation, VFX, lighting, and gameplay presentation.
  • Ensure the game retains the accessibility of a premium casual title while delivering the stage presence, spectacle, energy, and entertainment value expected from a major IP.
  • Review the game holistically and ensure all visual disciplines feel like part of the same cohesive experience.
  • Identify areas that feel generic, inconsistent, underdeveloped, or disconnected from the core fantasy and drive them toward stronger solutions.
  • Provide clear, actionable visual feedback through art reviews, paintovers, mockups, reference boards, and direct iteration.
  • Directly manage and mentor a small multidisciplinary art team spanning 2D, 3D, UI art, characters, environments, and VFX.
  • Set clear expectations, priorities, and quality standards while building a healthy culture of constructive critique and iteration.
  • Partner with Production on art priorities, capacity, dependencies, and delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with Creative Direction, Game Design, UX, Product, Engineering, and Production.
  • Work with UI/UX to ensure usability and clarity are supported by strong composition, hierarchy, visual storytelling, and presentation.
  • Guide VFX and animation toward a coherent language for anticipation, impact, transitions, rewards, celebration, and game feel.
  • Translate established IP and brand pillars into a modern mobile-game visual identity that feels authentic without becoming generic.
  • Participate in recruiting, portfolio reviews, and hiring as the art team evolves.

AI-Assisted Art Direction

AI-assisted creative workflows are an important part of how UserWise approaches game development.

The Art Director will be expected to actively champion and help evolve the use of AI across the art team.

You will:

  • Explore and incorporate AI tools where they can accelerate ideation, concept development, visualization, reference creation, iteration, and production.
  • Help artists use AI as a creative multiplier, not as a substitute for artistic judgment, craftsmanship, or ownership.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive production work and increase the amount of time the team spends on high-value creative decisions.
  • Establish workflows that combine AI-assisted exploration with traditional 2D, 3D, UI, animation, VFX, and engine-based production.
  • Evaluate emerging tools and techniques based on whether they genuinely improve quality, speed, or creative range.
  • Maintain strong artistic standards, visual consistency, and IP integrity as these workflows evolve.

We are looking for someone who is excited to actively shape how AI-assisted workflows can augment the creativity, capabilities, and output of a talented art team.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience as an Art Director, Associate Art Director, Lead Artist, or equivalent visual leadership role in games.
  • A portfolio demonstrating an exceptionally strong visual bar and clear artistic judgment.
  • Shipped experience on mobile Free-to-Play games.
  • Strong experience with casual or mass-market mobile games.
  • Proven experience managing and directing multidisciplinary artists.
  • Demonstrated ability to direct visual quality across multiple disciplines.
  • Strong visual judgment across 2D character and concept art, UI, environments, 3D characters, animation, VFX, lighting, composition, color, and visual hierarchy.
  • Ability to provide effective visual feedback through paintovers, mockups, references, or direct iteration.
  • Strong understanding of how UI, art, animation, VFX, lighting, and audio combine to create game feel and emotional payoff.
  • Experience working closely with UI/UX, game design, product, engineering, and production teams.
  • Ability to balance a strong artistic point of view with readability, performance, technical constraints, and production realities.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain not only what should change visually, but why.
  • Professional fluency in spoken and written English is required.
  • Comfortable working in Unity or closely within a real-time game-engine production environment.
  • Comfortable managing a distributed, international team.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for adopting and advancing AI-assisted creative workflows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with major entertainment, television, film, toy, or other licensed IP.
  • Experience adapting an established brand into a distinctive mobile-game visual identity.
  • Experience with game-show, social, party, board, puzzle, Match-3, coin-looter, or adjacent mass-market genres.
  • Experience on games with strong progression, characters, collection systems, rewards, and highly expressive moment-to-moment feedback.
  • Experience developing art-direction bibles, style guides, visual systems, and scalable LiveOps content standards.
  • Experience with generative AI, AI-assisted 3D workflows, or other emerging creative technologies.

Portfolio

A strong portfolio is essential for this role.

We are particularly interested in portfolios that demonstrate:

  • Shipped mobile and F2P work
  • Casual or mass-market visual sensibility
  • Art direction across complete game experiences rather than isolated assets
  • Multidisciplinary direction across 2D, 3D, UI, characters, environments, animation, or VFX
  • Paintovers, visual development, style exploration, or examples showing how you elevated the work of a team
  • The ability to create a cohesive visual identity across multiple disciplines

Where possible, please identify your specific role and contribution to the projects shown.

Benefits

Why Join UserWise

  • Help bring a globally recognized IP to life with real brand reach and growth potential.
  • Own and elevate the visual direction of a flagship mobile game across 2D, 3D, UI, animation, VFX, and presentation.
  • Help shape modern, AI-assisted creative workflows that amplify the capabilities of a talented art team.
  • Work with a veteran-led team in a lean, high-ownership environment.
  • High visibility and direct creative impact on the product.
  • 100% remote, flexible work with a small, passionate, execution-focused team.

Benefits

  • Market-competitive compensation
  • Paid Time Off
  • Performance Bonus
  • Annual Performance Reviews

About the role

Rate is looking for a strategic, hands-on Art Director to join our Creative team.

You’ll partner closely with Creative Directors, designers, copywriters, project managers, video and marketing partners to create work that feels elevated, intentional and distinctly Rate.

This is a fast-paced, high-volume environment, so we’re looking for someone who combines strong creative judgment with organization, ownership and proactive communication. You should be comfortable navigating ambiguity, solving problems independently and moving work forward without sacrificing quality.

What you’ll do

  • Concept and execute creative from initial idea through final production
  • Develop campaign concepts, visual identities and scalable design systems that work across multiple channels
  • Lead creative across paid and organic social, digital, email, OOH, print, events, partnerships and other brand touchpoints
  • Translate business objectives and creative briefs into thoughtful, compelling visual solutions
  • Remain hands-on in the work while also providing clear art direction and feedback to other designers
  • Partner with copywriters and other creative team members to build cohesive concepts and brand stories
  • Present work to Creative leadership and cross-functional stakeholders with confidence and clearly articulate the thinking behind creative decisions
  • Own projects throughout the full creative process, including concept development, internal reviews, revisions, production and final delivery

  • Proactively communicate project status, workload, risks and timeline concerns before they impact delivery
  • Come prepared to creative reviews with work, context, questions and clear next steps
  • Maintain strong visual consistency across campaigns while identifying opportunities to evolve and elevate the Rate brand
  • Ensure final work is accurate, polished, production-ready and aligned with brand standards
  • Help develop and improve creative systems, templates and processes that allow the team to work efficiently and consistently
  • Stay current on design, advertising, social, motion and cultural trends and bring relevant inspiration back to the team

What we’re looking for

  • 6–7+ years of experience in art direction, brand design or a related creative role within an agency, studio or in-house creative team
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating conceptual thinking, polished execution and the ability to develop creative systems across digital, social and integrated campaigns
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign and Adobe Firefly, with the ability to incorporate generative AI thoughtfully into the creative process
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including design systems, auto layout, Figma Buzz and Figma Motion, with the ability to build scalable, production-ready creative
  • Strong proficiency in After Effects, with experience developing motion graphics, animation and digital content
  • Experience storyboarding and concepting motion-first creative, with a strong understanding of how static ideas translate into animation
  • Excellent typography, composition, layout, color and visual storytelling skills with a consistently high standard for craft and detail
  • Experience developing campaign identities and carrying a cohesive visual idea across multiple formats, channels and deliverables
  • Strong understanding of digital and social-first creative, including paid media, organic social, email, web and OOH
  • Ability to move fluidly between concepting, hands-on design, motion and AI-assisted production, selecting the right tools and approach for each project
  • Experience providing clear art direction and constructive feedback to designers
  • Strong presentation skills with the ability to clearly articulate creative thinking and confidently present work to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity and move projects forward with minimal direction while knowing when to ask questions or escalate concerns
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, shifting timelines and high-volume workloads without sacrificing quality
  • Proactive, clear communicator who raises workload, timing or project risks before they impact delivery
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability and follow-through from kickoff through final production
  • Collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to receive feedback, adapt quickly and help elevate the work of the broader creative team
  • Strong working knowledge of web, email and UX design principles, including responsive design, hierarchy and channel-specific limitations
  • Demonstrated curiosity around emerging creative technologies and AI tools, with the ability to use them to improve concepting, iteration and production efficiency while maintaining brand consistency

What success looks like

You bring strong ideas to the table and know how to turn them into polished, scalable creative.

You understand when a project needs a big conceptual idea and when it needs a smart, repeatable system. You’re able to guide other creatives while still jumping into the work yourself.

You communicate early, eliminate surprises and take ownership of your projects from beginning to end. When something is unclear or at risk, you ask questions and raise concerns before they become problems.

You’re comfortable balancing multiple priorities, adapting when things change and maintaining a high creative standard even in a fast-moving environment.

Most importantly, you help make both the work and thecreative team stronger.
